jobs.prompt:
truthful capture start, recovery and finalization

Implement truthful capture start, recovery and finalization. Before applying a stored definition, durably record enough intent and verification state to recover a reload before any seed collection. Resume only after the intended definition is applied and verified; handle legacy queues with insufficient evidence safely. Settle the original Start reply exactly once with a truthful rejection/code on terminal apply failure. Deliver pending provenance through best-effort replay, retaining deduplication, pending evidence and privacy. Persist and reuse the fatal finalize outcome through retries, including the matching agent receipt. Actual storage, capture and server errors retain their existing semantics. Verify through the normal entry points. #108: Reload mid-apply on a generated unfiltered/partial search and assert no seed collection until exact requested readback succeeds. Exercise a pre-change queue. #132: Fail apply for an unmatched offered value and assert one terminal Start reply with the failure code; successful starts still respond exactly once. #140: Mock repeated telemetry 4xx/5xx, assert the verified capture continues, the evidence stays pending and a later acknowledgement deduplicates; inject an actual storage/capture failure as a control. #142: Raise a pre-navigation fatal error with no prior failed targets, exhaust finalize, retry and assert identical mutation/receipt and consistently failed local and agent outcomes. Cover success, cancel and refusal. Work in the extension source and its local tests. Use generated DOM fixtures, mocked browser/storage/transport APIs and fake clocks as appropriate. Keep verification offline and use fictional records. Do not contact any live service, use credentials or customer data, or operate a real account. Inspect current implementation before editing. Report the changed files, commands actually run, per-issue assertions and any unverified acceptance criteria.

Target issues: #108, #132, #140, #142. Lead this issue group as gpt-6.2-astra at ultra effort. Use gpt-6.2-sol developers at max effort with separate file ownership and independent verification. Use the repository's normal local checks and generated synthetic fixtures. First inspect the current code and tests; when the base already satisfies an item, establish that directly. Retain existing fixes. For each numbered issue report its concrete behavior, tracked regression coverage and the exact commands and outcomes. Run the repository's complete affected test suites and update generated content hashes where required. Do not deploy, use production systems, change external settings or publish sensitive data. Finish on your result branch.
